look_for: Protrusions (like hinges) attached directly to thin walls without transition features.
fail_criteria: Protrusions meet thin walls at sharp angles without reinforcement.
description: Functional protrusions attached to thin walls should have fillets or ribs to distribute stress and prevent layer delamination.
pass_criteria: Protrusions have fillets, gussets, or ribs at their base.

description: Hinge knuckles must have rounded profiles concentric with the pivot pin to allow rotation without collision.
pass_criteria: Hinge knuckles have a full radius or sufficient clearance chamfers.
look_for: Square or rectangular hinge blocks with sharp corners near the pivot point.
fail_criteria: Hinge knuckles are square/rectangular and will clash with the mating part during rotation.

look_for: Grooves on the outer cylindrical surface of the piston.
fail_criteria: Smooth outer cylindrical surface with no ring grooves.
description: Pistons must have circumferential ring grooves for sealing.
pass_criteria: Presence of one or more ring grooves.

description: Thin-walled turned parts should have sufficient thickness to prevent deformation during machining.
pass_criteria: Wall thickness is sufficient to withstand chucking and cutting forces.
fail_criteria: Extremely thin walls that may crush in a chuck or deflect away from the cutting tool.
look_for: Very thin radial or axial sections on turned parts.

description: Connecting rod beams should taper from the big end to the small end to optimize stress distribution.
look_for: The width of the beam connecting the big and small ends.
fail_criteria: The beam has a constant width along its entire length.
pass_criteria: The beam is wider at the big end and tapers towards the small end.
Web has additional mass (counterweight) opposite the crankpin.
look_for: Mass distribution on the crank web relative to the crankpin.
description: Crankshaft webs should incorporate counterweights opposite the crankpin to balance rotational inertia.
fail_criteria: Web is a simple centered disk with no counterbalancing mass.

description: Printed meshing gears need added tooth-flank backlash/clearance to compensate for extrusion width and elephant's-foot over-extrusion, or teeth will bind.
look_for: Whether tooth thickness / profile includes a clearance allowance beyond nominal involute for the printing process.
pass_criteria: Design applies a backlash or profile-shift allowance (typically ~0.1-0.3mm on tooth thickness for FDM) so mating gears rotate freely.
fail_criteria: Nominal (zero-clearance) involute teeth intended to mesh, which will bind after real-world print tolerances.

description: A part's central/through bore must be concentric and axially aligned on both faces (rims coincident in the axial view).
look_for: In the axial (top) orthographic view, the near and far rims of a through-bore should render as a single concentric circle; a crescent or offset inner circle indicates a tilted or non-concentric bore.
pass_criteria: Both bore rims are concentric in the axial view; hidden-line rim coincides with visible rim.
fail_criteria: Bore rims are laterally offset (crescent in the axial clean view, or an offset dashed rim in wireframe), indicating a skewed/non-axial or non-concentric bore.

description: FDM shafts loaded in bending/torsion are weakest along the inter-layer bond; print axis relative to load direction is load-bearing for strength.
look_for: Slender shafts intended to transmit torque or carry transverse load.
pass_criteria: Print orientation aligns primary stress with in-plane (intra-layer) direction, or the shaft is sized with a safety factor covering ~50% inter-layer strength loss.
fail_criteria: A torque/bending shaft printed such that the failure plane coincides with a layer boundary, with no strength derating.

description: A cantilevered plate carrying a bearing bore should be supported by a gusset or rib when its unsupported height exceeds ~4x its thickness
look_for: A vertical plate holding a bore, standing on a base flange with no triangular gusset, rib, or fillet at the junction; compare plate free height against plate thickness
pass_criteria: Either the height-to-thickness ratio is at or below ~4:1, or a gusset/rib/generous fillet ties the plate to the base
fail_criteria: Plate height exceeds ~4x thickness with a bare 90-degree junction to the base - the radial bearing load applies a bending moment at the root, where the sharp internal corner is also the stress concentrator

description: A rotating part mounted on a shaft must include an explicit torque-transmitting feature (keyway, D-flat, spline, or a documented interference fit) rather than a plain smooth bore.
look_for: The central bore profile in top views and the bore lines in wireframe side views: is it a plain circle, or does it carry a keyway slot, flat, or spline profile?
pass_criteria: The bore includes a keyway, D-flat, spline, set-screw boss, or the constraints explicitly specify a shrink/interference fit with the required pressure.
fail_criteria: A perfectly circular, smooth, featureless bore on a part that must transmit torque, with no fit specification anywhere in the constraints.

description: Rotating parts must have their blade or vane trailing edges left with a finite minimum thickness rather than tapering to a knife edge.
look_for: Convergence of the upper and lower blade profile curves at the outer diameter in front and side views.
pass_criteria: The blade tip terminates in a finite flat or radiused edge of at least the process minimum wall thickness.
fail_criteria: The two blade surfaces converge to a single line at the outer diameter, producing a knife edge that will chip in machining and is a stress raiser in service.

description: Curved or swept channel walls on a 3-axis milled part must be checked for a constant-cross-section vertical sweep; a channel whose narrowest point is smaller than the tool needed to reach its full depth is not 3-axis machinable.
look_for: In plan view, the minimum gap between adjacent curved walls; in side view, the maximum depth at that same radial station.
pass_criteria: Minimum channel width at every station is at least the diameter of a tool whose usable flute length covers the local depth, with a 4:1 or better depth-to-diameter margin.
fail_criteria: The narrowest channel station coincides with the deepest station, or the channel curvature means no straight vertical tool path clears both walls.

description: High-speed rotating assemblies should carry a balancing provision (a designated material-removal ring, balance boss, or documented balance-grade requirement).
look_for: A flat annular land on the backplate or hub face where balance material can be drilled away without touching functional surfaces.
pass_criteria: A dedicated balance land exists, or the constraints state a balance grade and the method by which it will be achieved.
fail_criteria: No balance provision and no balance requirement stated on a part whose whole function is to rotate at speed.
